description: Poll a withdrawal until terminal (success is sent; sandbox is confirmed). Bounded by timeout_seconds (default 300, hard ceiling 900). Moves no money.

id.description: The deposit/withdrawal id returned by the matching create tool.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds (default 300, hard ceiling 900).

name: wallet_wait_withdrawal

post_sync_failed.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) AFTER this money-moving call failed. The money already moved (see the txid); the next balance read reflects it. This is never a failure of the operation itself.

title: Wait for withdrawal
